# shadcn Tailwind styles

This file is the unmodified `dist/tailwind.css` from the MIT-licensed
[`shadcn` 4.16.0 package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shadcn/v/4.16.0).
The adjacent license must accompany it. SHA-256: `bc7d83425702955b4cb67cb14ede9d603f9d912376d57a2d81d661094d2a782a`.

The site needs these styles, not the component-generator CLI. Keeping the
stylesheet here removes the CLI dependency tree without changing its CSS.
